page.layout: One page of text, with two engraved medallion portraits at the top centre (their legends are part of the illustrations). Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Single column of running text below the medallions. Signature at bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: AMPHION Iouis & Antiopes filius, Thebis regnauit anno à mundo condito 2636. ante Christum natum 1326.hic tam insignis muficus[?] extitit, vt testudinem à Mercurio accepisse dicatur:cuius etiam modulamine fingitur à Poëtis saxa ad extruendas Thebas illexisse, ac traxisse:quod sic interpretatur Eusebius in Chro. Fuerunt,inquit,duro corde,&(vt ita dicam)saxei quidam auditores. Cui concinit Horatius in arte Poëtica,dicens,

p.i: Dictus & Amphion Thebanae conditor vrbis, Saxa mouere sono testudinis,& prece blanda Ducere quò vellet. fuit haec sapientia quondam Publica priuatis,secernere sacra profanis, Concubitu prohibere vago,dare iura maritis: Oppida moliri,leges incidere ligno.

main_text.p: Hic, vi eloquentiae, suasit rudibus ac sparsim degentibus, in vnum vt conuenirent,ciuitatémque muro cingerent: vel, vt interpretatur Palephatus, lyrae beneficio Thebanum murum construxit.

NIOBE filia Tantali, soror Pelopis vxórque Amphionis fuit,cui elegantissimae formae filios septe ac filias totidem peperit: vnde se Latonae praetulit: quare indignata Dea hanc in saxum mutauit ( vt fabulantur Poëtae) occisis prius ab Apolline omnibus suis liberis. Ouid.6.lib.Metamorph.Diodor.lib.5.Palephatus inde datu locum fabulae scribit, quòd supra natorum suorum sepulchrum suam ipsius lapideam imaginem Niobe collocarit, eámq; se efferit ipse quoque Palephatus inspexisse imaginem.

page.notes: Two medallion engravings at top: left, a helmeted male head with legend "AMPHION" and "THEBANVS"; right, a female head with legend "NIOBE AMPHII" (partly "NIOBE · AMPHII"). Legends are part of the illustrations and are not transcribed as text. "muficus" is partly obscured by a red stain; the reading is doubtful and marked [?]. A red stain also sits over the text near "mufic" and should not be read as printed matter.
